READING
THE BINDING CALCULATION CANNOT PICK THE CATALYST. Best feature 'mean' at 0.450 with
the size control at 0.532. On a shortlist of ten, that is reordering at random.
This reproduces nexus_doesitbind's 0.456 at more than seven times the sample size and on
the population the task actually presents. Combined with the 0.998 a full screen would
need, the structural route to catalyst-finding is CLOSED with this machinery, and step 3
has nothing to compose -- reranking by a chance-level score cannot beat the language arm.
